domain(person,[ada,briella]).
% If Adeline pursues her passion, then she will achieve success.
axiom(s1,rule([pursues_passion(ada)],achieves_success(ada))).
% Adeline is intelligent or dedicated.
axiom(s2,or(intelligent(ada),dedicated(ada))).
% If Adeline sets goals, then she will work hard.
axiom(s3,rule([sets_goals(ada)],works_hard(ada))).
% If Adeline is dedicated, then she either has expertise or works hard (but not both).
axiom(s4,rule([dedicated(ada)],xor(has_expertise(ada),works_hard(ada)))).
% Adeline achieves success or has expertise.
axiom(s5,or(achieves_success(ada),has_expertise(ada))).
% Adeline does not shape the opinions of others.
axiom(s6,not(shapes_opinions_of_others(ada))).
% Adeline sets goals.
axiom(s7,sets_goals(ada)).
% If Adeline achieves success, then she will gain recognition.
axiom(s8,rule([achieves_success(ada)],gains_recognition(ada))).
% If someone makes discoveries and publishes research, then they will have influence in their field.
axiom(s9,rule([makes_discoveries(X),publishes_research(X)],has_influence_in_field(X))).
% If Adeline is passionate, then she is dedicated and cares about others.
axiom(s10,rule([passionate(ada)],and(dedicated(ada),cares_about_others(ada)))).
% Those who have influence in their field will shape the opinions of others.
axiom(s11,rule([has_influence_in_field(X)],shapes_opinions_of_others(X))).
% Briella sets goals.
axiom(s12,sets_goals(briella)).
% If someone gains recognition, then they will have influence in their field.
axiom(s13,rule([gains_recognition(X)],has_influence_in_field(X))).
